channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 146: The General's Order
item.description: General Qin Zhenyue walked up the summit road at dawn, alone, with his cap on.

item.title: Chapter 145: The Inner Gate
item.description: "We don't go through them," said Yuanshu. "We go under."

item.title: Chapter 144: Major Zhuo
item.description: Major Zhuo Wenli left a letter on the general's camp table, folded once, under a cup of tea he had made and not drunk.

item.title: Chapter 143: Ash
item.description: "Show me," said Yuanshu.

item.title: Chapter 142: Kindling
item.description: They tried it in row eighty, at dawn, with two hundred.

item.title: Chapter 141: The Mountain of Graves
item.description: There was no frost on the mountain.

item.title: Chapter 140: Inside
item.description: The message from inside the Mouth came at three in the morning on the twenty-third day, the long way, through the echo, the way they always came.

item.title: Chapter 139: One Point Three Seconds
item.description: Seed had kept the ring.

item.title: Chapter 138: The Juniper
item.description: They did not raise Lu Zhengtian, and they did not read him, and the whole city came to watch them not do it.

item.title: Chapter 137: Quiet Means Quiet
item.description: Lu Zhengtian walked across the round chamber in his good suit, between the dead.

item.title: Chapter 136: Look at the Floor
item.description: Lu stopped.

item.title: Chapter 135: Zero Hour
item.description: The pulse came at 02:31 on the seventeenth day, and they went down ten minutes later.

item.title: Chapter 134: The Sitting
item.description: They came on the fifteenth morning, before dawn, and sat down.

item.title: Chapter 133: Three Degrees
item.description: "I'd like to help," said Garrett Hale. "If I can. If you'd ask me."

item.title: Chapter 132: Not Mine
item.description: The keeper said it before he finished asking.

item.title: Chapter 131: The Adjutant
item.description: He read the night at noon, in the keeper's hut, with the door open and Sister Ning sitting on the step.

item.title: Chapter 130: Next to Stone Seven
item.description: Su Mingli folded them one more time, and it nearly killed her.

item.title: Chapter 129: The Grain Exchange
item.description: The thing that came up under the old Grain Exchange was two hundred meters long, and it came up through the building.

item.title: Chapter 128: Downhill
item.description: "We can't kill them," said Su Mingli, "and we can't let them through."

item.title: Chapter 127: Rift Weather
item.description: Seed called the time to the minute, and the rifts opened on it.
